## Morning Roast

Morning Roast is the fan/community name for Moon Dancer’s sister, a quiet adult unicorn seen in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is easiest to recognize at the surprise reunion party in “Amending Fences,” when Moon Dancer realizes even her sister has come to support her. [G4 unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies).

**Appearance:** Pale cream coat; pinkish-coral mane and tail curled into distinctive buns, with darker streaks; prominent eyebrows; purple eyes; and a blue coffee-mug cutie mark with a reddish handle.

**Name and voice:** The character and sister relationship belong to the G4 television continuity, but *Morning Roast* is an unofficial identification name. In the episode, Moon Dancer calls her “my sister,” not “Morning Roast”; I found no verified official naming credit, naming origin, spoken line, or voice actor for her. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Amending_Fences). An independent *D20 Pony* fan story calls its interpretation of Moon Dancer’s sister **Dawn Break**; that is a fan-continuity name, not a confirmed television alias. [D20 Pony story/art post](https://twibooru.org/2836736).

**Appearances:** “Amending Fences” (S5E12, her main scene); then background appearances in “The Cutie Re-Mark — Part 1” (S5E25), “Parental Glideance” (S7E7), “Yakity-Sax” (S8E18), and “The Washouts” (S8E20).

## Important moments

1. **She shows up for her sister — “Amending Fences” (S5E12).** After Moon Dancer breaks down about being abandoned, her sister arrives alongside the librarian and bookseller. Their presence helps show Moon Dancer she is still cared for. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AIY5iEEzNlo) (scene timestamp unavailable).
2. **The sisters embrace — “Amending Fences” (S5E12).** Moon Dancer hugs her sister at the reconciliation party, an especially clear visual confirmation of their relationship. The [episode stills catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Moon_Dancer_images) lists “Moon Dancer hugging her sister S5E12”; scene timestamp unavailable.
